doc.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023

title: Dream project with a blank check
summary: An animated jazz musical using her musician friends and old Waller and Ellington material.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: If you had a blank check, sort of following up on what you just said, what’s your dream — do you have a dream project that someone else funds?
A blank check? You mean like even a hundred million dollars would be okay?
Well that’s a pretty large check, maybe just —
I need to know. I need to know because I do have a project in mind but it might be pretty expensive, maybe 50 million. Well let’s — can we not put a dollar amount on it?

Okay. An animated jazz musical. That would be my dream. And I could use all the incredible singers and musicians I know. And I’d sing on it too but that wouldn’t be the main point. And I could write things with my co-writers, I could also use some old music — the Fats Waller and Duke Ellington things I’ve done with lyrics or do some more. You’d have to put aside some money for a legal team because the rights to those things are always a little bit difficult to attain. But yeah, that would be my absolute dream.
